notes: Samsung's spec table prints Folded/Unfolded as WIDTH x HEIGHT x DEPTH -- the second value is identical folded and unfolded (the hinge-axis dimension), so it is mapped to `height` and the first value to `width`. NEW MODEL: the first 'Ultra' in the Galaxy Z Fold line, announced alongside the Z Fold8 at Galaxy Unpacked on 2026-07-22. It keeps the Z Fold7 footprint (72.8 x 158.4 folded / 143.2 x 158.4 unfolded, 8.9mm folded, 215 g) and differs in unfolded thickness: 4.1mm vs the Z Fold7's 4.2mm -- both values were read from their own press releases, not carried across. Unfolded thickness footnote: 'does not include the frame of the main screen'. Single folded thickness -> depth_at_hinge null. Samsung gives no frame/back/cover-glass material in this release -> materials null. 'Flex Titanium' is a display support structure (titanium-alloy film + titanium plate) that 'helps minimize the display crease', not a statement of crease SHAPE -> crease null. General availability 2026-08-07 per Samsung's separate launch release. RESOLUTION ORDERING: recorded verbatim as Samsung prints it. Samsung is NOT consistent across generations -- the 2025 Z Fold7 table prints '(2184 x 1968)' and '(2520 x 1080, 21:9)' (long axis first) while the 2026 Z Fold8 / Fold8 Ultra table prints '(1,848 x 2,448)', '(1,248 x 1,972)' and '(1,080 x 2,520)' (short axis first).
